entries.heading: None of the funds made available by this Act nor any
ancestors: DIVISION K—TRANSPORTATION, HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2017
TITLE II—DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT
entries.text:
Sec. 229.  None of the funds made available by this Act nor any 
receipts or amounts collected under any Federal Housing Administration 
program may be used to implement the Homeowners Armed with Knowledge 
(HAWK) program.
